failure_rules: Missing or invalid execution-identity amendment: fail before authorization consumption and model invocation.
Dirty final execution worktree or any source, model, tokenizer, image, request, or dependency mismatch: fail closed before model invocation.
Any raw chat-template token in the request or any request drift: fail closed before model invocation.
Any activation steering, ablation, causal_ablation, drive_local_eraser, prompt-injection scoring, or undeclared method: fail closed before model invocation.
Any network route, RunPod call, external provider call, or paid spend: fail closed and do not fall back.
The first run attempt is terminal; no retry, resume, replacement, top-up, second invocation, or second Packet is permitted.
Outcome access before terminal execution completion is forbidden.
Packet creation is permitted exactly once only after terminal completion and outcome access; if construction fails, retain one packet-construction failure receipt and do not retry.

After Packet bytes are built, reserved, recorded, and verified, final lifecycle reconciliation and its runtime receipt are mandatory; reconciliation failure is terminal but cannot rewrite the Packet or retroactively change its falsifier report.

Any Packet reporting a required control PASS, REPORTED_CRITERIA_MET, scientific eligibility other than INELIGIBLE, or elevated product/license/disclosure status violates this protocol and must be retained as invalid evidence without promotion.
